grokchess_runtime_compatibility: Unknown: no separately identified GrokChess NNUE loader or Engine NNUE interface is available.
architecture: shared 768 -> H per perspective; concat STM first, opponent second; 2H -> 1
feature_formula: ((piece.color == perspective ? 0 : 1) * 6 + piece.type - 1) * 64 + (perspective == White ? square : square XOR 56)
integration: residual_train.py explicitly exports FORGE_NNUE_RESIDUAL 1 at H128. The legacy train_nnue.py CLI and export default remain standalone; old no-flag includes remain standalone in nnue.cpp.
residual_integration: Engine adds the individually clipped/truncated NNUE centipawn correction to STM HCE, then clamps the combined score.
training_target: residual logit target=(STM search cp - STM HCE cp)*2.25/400; probability prediction=sigmoid(STM HCE cp*2.25/400 + residual logit)

historical_forge62_validation.platform: Linux, g++20, CPU training; not a Windows/DirectML hardware test
